THE AZURE ARCHITECTURE

Technology with
a defined job.

A shipment’s condition can change between collection and delivery. Images, door events and temperature histories must be reviewed repeatedly across many active loads.

Follow the full processing path ↗
  1. 01

    Azure IoT Hub

    Receive shipment temperature readings and equipment events from authorized devices.

    Planned integration
  2. 02

    Azure Machine Learning

    Evaluate changes in produce images alongside the shipment’s temperature history.

    Planned integration
  3. 03

    Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry

    Explain the condition warning and identify the evidence the receiving operator should check.

    Connector implemented · configure Azure deployment
  4. 04

    Azure Blob Storage

    Keep checkpoint images and quality review records attached to the shipment.

    Planned integration
